measurement: Thigh liner size matches your Unloader One brace size, XS to XL; order the same size as your current brace frame. If unsure of your size, measure calf circumference 6 in. below mid-patella with the leg extended and match to the Unloader One brace size chart. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
